==Description==
The '''Rainbow Nametag''' is an animated nametag obtained from the [[Gamepasses|VIP]] gamepass, which can be bought for {{Robux|300}}. It can be claimed from the [[Gift Box]].

Both versions are animated nametags which have gradient text which quickly changes colors with a black outline.

==Trivia==
*Prior to the 26th of May 2023, there was no nametag inventory despite there being two publicly available nametags, which meant that purchasing the [[Gamepasses|VIP]] gamepass would permanently apply the '''Rainbow Nametag''' until that date.
**Purchasing the [[Gamepasses|VIP]] gamepass in-game would not apply the '''Rainbow Nametag''' until you joined the game again.
